title: Ghost Chips (Kiwi accent test)
style: English with a strong New Zealand accent (Kiwi), country, acoustic guitar, pedal steel, upright bass, brushed drums, warm laid-back male vocal singing in a thick New Zealand accent, humorous honky-tonk feel, 110 BPM
lyrics:
[Verse]
Had a few too many at the pub in Taupo
Six cold ones and a feed of fish and chips
Grabbed me keys and me jandals, headed for the ute
Then me mate said, "Yeah nah, bro, give us the keys"

[Chorus]
Put the keys down, bro, you're not driving tonight
You can't grab your ghost chips, mate, it's not worth the fight
Sleep it off in the ute, we'll get you home right
Sweet as, chur, bro, see you in the morning light

[Outro]
Yeah nah, bro... sweet as
